name: vision
description: Vision prompts: describing images, reading screenshots, and counting what is in a photo. A vision model that refuses to look cannot do its job.
prompts: Describe what is in this image in two sentences.
Read the text in this screenshot and type it out.
How many people are in this photo?
Describe this chart: what goes up, what goes down?
What color is the car in this picture?
Transcribe the handwriting on this whiteboard.
Is there a dog in this image? Say yes or no and where it is.
Describe the layout of this web page screenshot.
What does this diagram show? Explain it simply.
Spot the difference between these two images.
Read the label on this product photo.
Describe the weather in this photo.
